messages:
Lina: quick follow-up to the onboarding pipeline convo 81. thinking we need a formal boundary between intake->registry->runtime so teams can reason about safe rollouts.
Omar: agree. current flow is messy: ingest writes files, runtime discovers, router guesses. we've had two incidents from stale binaries.
Priya: proposal: introduce a tiny "admit record" object in the registry (immutable versions) that includes fingerprint, variant, bench_state, and minimal capabilities. router only reads admit records.
Jules: admit record sounds good. what states do we need? my rough list: pending, in_progress, passed, failed, stale.
Kai: and a "policy" pointer: teams can opt into relaxed passes (e.g., allow_partial=true) for internal dev models. default strict for public.
Lina: how do we handle timing? bench can take hours. we should let models serve behind canary if they pass quick-smoke. define quick-smoke thresholds so runtime probes remain meaningful.
Omar: quick-smoke should be <500ms and cover shape, ops, and a KV consistency check. if smoke fails, don't admit.
Priya: we need a compact wire format for admit records. suggestion: {id, ver, fingerprint, variant, capabilities, bench_state, bench_meta_url}. keep bench_meta out of hot path.
Jules: +1. bench_meta_url points to detailed results in object-store. registry stores only a small pointer and summary fields (p95, tokens/sec, cost_est).
Kai: runtime needs a small set of capability flags like ["kv_cache","multi_shard","fp16"]. router rules evaluate these quickly. store as comma-separated string to keep registry schema simple.
Lina: rollout semantics: when bench_state==pending router uses admission policy: traffic_percent (default 1%) + canary_duration (default 24h). after passed, increase per team policy. manual overrides via Console.
Omar: we should also version the handshake. field "admit_schema_v": "1". that way we can evolve without breaking older runtimes.
Priya: for legacy models without fingerprint we run a backfill job that computes fingerprint and enqueue bench. mark them as legacy_mode until backfill done. router treats legacy_mode as conservative.
Jules: corner case: partial bench results. Some tests flaky. we can support a per-test whitelist in bench_meta and a top-level pass_threshold (e.g., 90%). default is strict (all must pass).
Kai: automation: bench produces machine-readable verdict + human notes. registry will store verdict and a short-msg field. Console surfaces failing tests to owning team.
Lina: infra question: where do admit records live? etcd or db? needs atomic update and fast reads for router.
InfraBot: registry-store provisioned: etcd cluster with read-optimized replicas. write API: PUT /registry/admit/{model_id}/{ver}  returns 200 on success. replication lag <50ms in-region.
Omar: nice. router should cache admit records in-memory and subscribe to changestream so we don't hammer etcd. cache TTL short (5s) and invalidate on change.
Priya: runtime smoke probes: define 3 canned prompts, max seq=256, check kv_get/put roundtrip and a checksum result. probe must be idempotent and safe. runtime aborts model if >1 probe fails.
Jules: also include deterministic golden token checksum for each variant so quick checks can detect regressions. bench still runs full evals.
Kai: security: bench_meta_url must be signed URLs if private. registry should never leak detailed evals. store only summary and pointer.
Lina: operational playbook: if bench_state stays pending >48h, alert owner and mark admit stale; router enforces 0% traffic for stale by default.
Omar: add a migration plan: stage 1: new admits for all new models. stage 2: backfill fingerprints for existing models over 2 weeks. stage 3: flip router to read admit records only.
Priya: tests for this rollout: integration test that writes admit -> router picks up -> runtime rejects bad model. also e2e for canary ramping.
Jules: I'll write the adaptor RFC for admit record schema and router semantics. Kai will draft Console UI bits. Lina will codify rollout defaults.
Kai: will do Console mockups and team opt-in flow.
InfraBot: bench-queue-beta: POST /bench/queue {model_id, variant}  avg ETA 3h. added region affinity note at https://internal.redwood/bench/beta.
Lina: thanks all. if no objections i'll merge the small schema RFC and kick off infra tickets. target: ship primitives next sprint. :thumbsup:
Omar: no objections from me.
Priya: lgtm.
Jules: on it.
Kai: queued mockups now.
